focal_point: One hero product photograph and one full-width offer strip.
eye_path: From the product photograph to a short playful headline, then to the offer strip.
grid: One photograph, one short headline, one full-width offer strip.
scale_ratios: The offer strip is the one loud element. The headline stays short.
type_choices: One short playful display line. The offer is larger than the headline.
photo_art_direction: One hero product photograph, not a cluttered scene.
offer_placement: One full-width dollars off offer strip, with a barcode and an expiry kept with that offer.
trust_and_cta: A barcode and an expiry sit with the offer strip.
emulate: A super simple food or retail coupon: one hero product photo, a short playful headline, one big full-width offer strip, a barcode, and an expiry. Learn the simplicity. Do not copy the layout.
do_not_copy: The mark, the colors, the offer figure, the barcode, the expiry date, the product, the photograph, and the wording.
anti_patterns: Do not turn the offer strip, the barcode, or the expiry into a template to trace.
summary: Owner favorite. Dairy Queen cake coupon, one face. A restaurant insert. The lesson is a super simple food or retail coupon: one hero product photo, a short playful headline, one big full-width offer strip, a barcode, and an expiry. Style reference only.
